contract.alphabets: A fixed source-letter alphabet and a fixed working-glyph alphabet, with one input letter producing exactly one output glyph. Each table row is injective; equal22-element alphabets make it bijective.
contract.state: At every word start use one public reset row. At all subsequent positions select the row solely from the immediately previous WRITTEN output glyph. No hidden state, additional within-word reset, deletion, expansion, letter omission or source-dependent spelling alternative.
contract.equation: For source letters x_i and generated glyphs y_i, y_1=f_BOS(x_1) and y_i=f_{y_(i-1)}(x_i) for i>=2.
contract.inverse: x_1=f_BOS^{-1}(y_1); x_i=f_{y_(i-1)}^{-1}(y_i). The decoder uses the observed previous output glyph, not a guessed previous source letter.
contract.not_full_writer: This conditional capacity contract does not by itself supply a source projection, punctuation, names outside the declared alphabet, physical continuation or a useful vocabulary. No complete medieval writer or native alphabet is claimed.

run_lemma.statement: A within-word output run y_a...y_(a+k-1)=g^k, k>=2, entails x_(a+1)=...=x_(a+k-1)=f_g^{-1}(g). Thus a contiguous source run of at least k-1 equal letters is necessary.
run_lemma.proof: Every position after the first glyph of the output run has the same previous written glyph g and the same present output g. Injectivity of f_g supplies exactly one source letter at all those positions. The first position may use another previous-glyph row or BOS and is not included in the forced tail.
run_lemma.word_edge: The proof holds when a=1, because only the first position uses the reset row. It cannot be applied across a word boundary. An additional reset inside a counted run would violate the stated contract.
run_lemma.weak_case: A double gg requires only a one-letter source tail. It does not imply two equal source letters. A triple ggg is the first nonvacuous repeated-source-letter obligation.
run_lemma.no_type_injection: The source letter f_g^{-1}(g) can be the same for several different output glyphs g. Row-wise bijectivity does not make g -> f_g^{-1}(g) globally injective. Distinct repeated output forms cannot simply be counted as distinct repeated source letters.

hand_examples: AB -> gg: an output double without an input double.
ABB -> ggg: the initial source A differs, while the required tail is BB.
ABBB -> gggg: a source run of3 supplies an output run of4.
BBB -> hhh: both output-run labels g and h can correspond to the same repeated input B.
manual_toy.execution: These are direct hand substitutions in three stated two-entry rows. No program or data experiment was run.

possible_cheap_bounds: If a fixed complete source population has no run of k-1 equal letters, no row table can generate an output word containing a run of k equal glyphs. More generally maximum within-word output run length is at most maximum within-word input run length plus1.

For aligned complete source/output words and fixed k, each equal-glyph output window of length k at positions a...a+k-1 injects into the equal-letter source window a+1...a+k-1. Overlapping windows must be counted as windows on both sides.

For a source word of length L, the sharper source-window capacity sums constant windows of length k-1 whose starting position is i=2,...,L-k+2 in the chosen processing direction. The first source window cannot be charged to a nonexistent output position0. Counting all source windows instead is a safe but weaker relaxation.

An empirical comparison needs a declared common population and normalization. A total over one complete source cannot be compared as a deterministic count bound with an unrelated crop or a differently sized target sample. Root must choose the source and population before any such count.
orientation_and_units: Reversing the source word before applying the rule preserves the existence and lengths of source constant runs; the exceptional unforced first position moves to the other end of the original word. The sharper window capacity omits the original final window instead of its first.

Reversing the displayed ciphertext is not automatically the same table family in the original left-to-right orientation. The state is previous in the actual processing direction. The existential run-length consequence survives either declared direction.
Any reversal must operate on declared working units, not the ASCII letters inside a multicharacter label such as ch. Word boundaries and the one-unit/one-letter assumption remain explicit.
word_building_and_invariants: An exactly repeated output substring has the same decoded source suffix from its SECOND glyph onward. Its first decoded letter can differ when its preceding written glyph differs. It therefore does not by itself identify a whole morpheme or shared meaning.

At word reset, the complete mapping is deterministic and invertible. Exact source-word equality, whole-word frequency multiplicities, adjacent whole-word repetitions and word lengths are preserved. The channel can alter internal glyph-transition statistics, but does not solve a fixed source word-frequency failure.
No daldy-family part, q, y, run glyph or other native item receives a source letter or meaning in this note.
